# x402 HMAC Toolkit

Compute HMAC signatures (SHA-256 / SHA-512) for message authentication.

- POST /api/hmac  { key, message, algorithm?, encoding? }
- Free discovery: GET /catalog
- Price: ~0.003–0.008 USDC per call
- Uses Node crypto only (no external libs). Key never logged.

Agent use cases: request signing, webhook verification helpers, API auth primitives, integrity checks.
